JYP Entertainment, a South Korean multinational entertainment and record label, recently pulled back the curtain on its plans for all the groups in 2025, setting the stage for yet another thrilling year in[K-pop.](https://www.news18.com/movies/new-k-pop-group-close-your-eyes-struggles-with-fans-overwhelming-attention-at-airport-aa-9175937.html) With a mix of new world tours of groups under the label and the release of new albums, K-pop fanatics can expect non-stop entertainment from the artists. Here’s what the groups under JYP Entertainment have in store for 2025.

**DAY6**

Recommended Stories
-------------------

After releasing two EPs in 2024, the now-quartet comprising Sungjin, Young K, Wonpil, and Dowoon made history by becoming the first band to perform at the Gocheok Sky Dome in 2024. The group will continue with their biggest world tour titled Forever Young in 2025, with its last show scheduled in May in Jakarta.

**TWICE**

In 2025, the nine-membered girl group will be busy with group, unit and solo activities. Their Japanese sub-unit MiSaMo recently achieved a milestone by becoming the fastest K-pop group to perform six dome concerts across three cities in Japan. A brand new world tour is also on the horizon for TWICE.

**Stray Kids**

Continuing with their meteoric rise in the global music industry, the eight-member band recorded some remarkable achievements last year. Their latest tour, Dominate, witnessed a whopping 2.2 million attendees across 55 shows in 34 locations around the world. Their dominance in U.S. sales charts remains unmatched, ranking second in overall CD sales, first among K-Pop artists, ranking at one on Billboard 200 for six consecutive albums and 3 times consecutively on the Billboard Hot 100. In 2025, Stray Kids is expected to release two albums.

**ITZY**

Fans of the quintet can expect both group and solo activities, including new albums and tours, in 2025. Moreover, with ITZY’s Yeji already making waves for her solo debut, fans can also expect another solo debut from the rest of the members.

**NMIXX**

The six-member K-pop girl group under JYP is set to drop a new mini album in 2025. Following this, they will also embark on a series of fan concerts across Latin America and Asia. Their ever-growing popularity has also led to an increase in their brand deals.

**KickFlip**

Names as one of the “Top 8 K-Pop Rookies to Watch in 2025" by the Recording Academy, the septet has been making waves both domestically and internationally. Debuting in January 2025 with the EP Flip It, Kick It, their streaming numbers have continued to surge. They already have a whopping 1 million followers on TikTok.

**NiziU**

The nine-membered Japanese girl group formed under the label is set to broaden their reach in 2025. They will be releasing their second Korean single soon. Moreover, the rookie group’s concerts NiziU Live with U 2025 & 2026, are scheduled to take place in 21 cities during the second half of 2025.

**NEXZ**

Fresh off winning the Top 5 New Artist award at the Japan Gold Disc Awards, NEXZ was also among the “Top 8 K-Pop Rookies to Watch in 2025" list released by the Recording Academy. With new album releases, Korean and Japanese concerts and a plan to expand their merchandise, the group surely has a lot in store for 2025.

**Others**

Another artist under the group, VCHA, is gearing up for their comeback in the first half of 2025 with localised content. L2K and Project C will make their debut. The company also has plans to expand its artist base by introducing new ones in 2026.

| _JYP Entertainment_

DAY6

The band made history as the first to hold a concert at the Gocheok Sky Dome in 2024. In 2025, they will continue their massive world tour and are set to perform at a stadium in Jakarta this May.

TWICE
-----

TWICE members will take part in a mix of group, unit, and solo projects. Their sub-unit, **Misamo**, achieved an impressive milestone by performing six dome concerts in three Japanese cities. A new world tour is also expected in 2025.

Stray Kids
----------

Stray Kids are experiencing record-breaking success, with their recent tour drawing over 2.2 million attendees across 55 shows in 34 locations. They continue to dominate U.S. sales charts, ranking second in overall CD sales and first among K-Pop artists. Additionally, they have topped the Billboard 200 with six consecutive albums and appeared on the Billboard Hot 100 three times in a row. In 2025, they will release two new albums and aim to reach even more miletones.

ITZY
----

Fans can look forward to both group and solo activities, with new albums and tours scheduled for 2025. With Yeji already in the middle of promoting her solo debut, will fans see another solo debut in the horizon?

NMIXX
-----

The group plans to release a mini-album and hold fan concerts in Latin America and Asia. Their growing popularity has also led to increased advertisement deals.

KickFlip
--------

Named one of the “Top 8 K-Pop Rookies to Watch in 2025” by the Recording Academy, KickFlip has been gaining traction both domestically and globally, especially in streaming. They recently hit one million TikTok followers.

NiziU
-----

The group will expand their activities outside Japan, releasing a second Korean single. Their concerts, _NiziU Live with U 2025 & 2026_, are set to take place in 21 cities during the second half of 2025.

NEXZ
----

After winning a “Top 5 New Artist” award at the Japan Gold Disc Awards, NEXZ also secured a spot in the Recording Academy’s “Top 8 K-Pop Rookies to Watch in 2025.” They will have new album releases and concerts in both Korea and Japan, alongside merchandise expansion featuring their NEXZOO character and official light sticks.

**VCHA** is preparing for a comeback in the first half of 2025 with localized content. **L2K** and **Project****C** are also set to debut, and the company plans to introduce new artists in 2026.

_Disney+_’s upcoming K-Drama _Knockoff_, starring **Kim****Soo****Hyun**, is reportedly facing a delay following the actor’s recent controversy. ![Image 8: kim soo hyun queen of tears still](https://image.koreaboo.com/2025/03/kim-soo-hyun-queen-of-tears-still-1-925x617.jpg)

| _tvN_

_Knockoff_ follows a man whose life is upended by the 1997 Asian financial crisis, leading him to become a major figure in the counterfeit goods market. Kim Soo Hyun takes on the role of Kim Sung Joon, vice president of Saemmul Market, while **Jo****Bo****Ah** plays Song Hye Jung, a special judicial officer targeting counterfeit operations. With a significant budget and a second season already confirmed, the series had been generating considerable buzz.

![Image 9: knockoff](https://image.koreaboo.com/2025/03/knockoff.jpg)

| _Disney_

However, recent allegations that Kim Soo Hyun was romantically involved with the late actress **Kim Sae Ron** when she was underage have thrown the production into uncertainty. If the issue remains unresolved, the actor may be unable to attend promotional events, and in the worst case, the K-Drama’s release could even be reconsidered. _Disney_ _Korea_ has responded to such speculation by stating that a final release date has yet to be confirmed.

Among them is **Safety****Zone****Korea**, South Korea’s first-ever streetwear brand, which had invested in the project. CEO **Park****Ki****Pyo** expressed disappointment over the situation, stating that the company will wait for Disney’s decision before making an official statement.

> As a company that values youthful energy and innovative branding, we collaborated with Knockoff in its production. However, this unforeseen scandal has disrupted the project, which is truly regrettable. We will determine our official stance after Disney releases its decision.
> 
> 
> — Park Ki Pyo
